function.name: entropy_change_calculate
function.description: Calculate the change in entropy for a mass of a specific substance under set initial and final conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The question: "一個1公斤的冰塊在0°C被加熱到100°C，在1大氣壓下，其熵變化為多少焦耳/開氏度？" Means: a 1 kg ice block at 0°C heated to 100°C at 1 atm. We need entropy change in J/K. We need to consider: heating ice from 0°C to 0°C? Actually ice at 0°C, then melting at 0°C, then heating water from 0°C to 100°C. So we need to compute ΔS = ΔS_melt + ΔS_heat_water. For ice melting at 0°C at 1 atm, latent heat of fusion L_f = 334 kJ/kg. So ΔS_melt = m * L_f / T (T=273.15 K). So ΔS_melt = 1 kg * 334000 J/kg / 273.15 K = 1222 J/K approx. Then heating water from 0°C to 100°C: use specific heat capacity of water c_p = 4184 J/(kg·K). ΔS_heat_water = m * c_p * ln(T_final/T_initial) = 1 kg * 4184 J/(kg·K) * ln(373.15/273.15). ln(373.15/273.15) = ln(1.366) ≈ 0.312. So ΔS_heat_water ≈ 4184 * 0.312 = 1305 J/K.
